messages:
maya: quick ping — can runtime + platform + security take a look at PR #55678? This touches the KV prefetch eviction path and the routing fallback. Hoping to merge tomorrow 09:00 PT. cc @sam @anika @kevin

sam: reading now. can you paste the canary plan and owners? also who should own rollback/monitoring?

maya: Canary plan: 10% for 1h -> 50% for 30m -> full. Owners: runtime: maya/jordyn, platform: sam, infra: kevin, security: anika. Rough rollout command in our checkout:
```
./tools/release --pr 55678 --canary 10 --step 50 --wait 3600
```
(not an actual prod CLI, just shorthand)

anika: quick sec note: does this change touch any token handling or auth headers? skimming it looks fine, but please add an audit flag on the fallback path so we have traceability. If you add `audit=true` in the fallback log path I can sign off.

kevin: infra check — e2e is failing on redis compat in CI. maya, I pushed a small compat fix to infra/redis-compat branch; can you rebase and re-run CI? also we should pick a migration window for the redis replica swap — prefer 10:30 PT to match low traffic.

maya: rebased onto your compat fix and re-ran tests, unit + e2e now green. pushed commit 3f9a1d that includes the `audit=true` flag on the fallback, and added a tiny doc note in the PR about the replica swap. @sam any platform/perf concerns?

sam: ran the perf job against a staging snapshot. p50/p95 unchanged, p99 improved slightly under the eviction scenario (good). LGTM from platform side. one ask: add a short note in the PR description about expected KV hit-rate change so ops can correlate. jordyn — can you confirm runtime semantics under concurrent requests?

jordyn: looked through the runtime changes and checked the KV eviction logic. semantics look preserved. suggestion (non-blocking): lower eviction threshold from 0.95 -> 0.9 to avoid late spikes. i'm +1 otherwise.

anika: sec +1 with the audit flag included. adding security label now.

kevin: infra +1 after the redis fix. agree with 10:30 PT migration/merge window so replicas are swapped beforehand.

maya: thanks all. scheduling merge at 10:30 PT and assigning canary owners: sam (platform), jordyn (runtime), kevin (infra). I'll monitor logs and be ready to rollback if error rate spikes. deploy-bot: please schedule merge at our requested time.

deploy-bot: scheduled merge for PR 55678 at 1767781800 — CI: all checks passed :white_check_mark:

sam: :thumbsup:

maya: will post a quick post-deploy note in #incidents if anything odd shows up.
